# Norvia Labs

> Norvia Labs is an open-source experiment lab shipping focused, MIT-licensed tools for AI builders — an agent harness, a control-plane gateway, and layers for contracts, routing, and audit. No accounts, no closed tiers: the library or CLI on GitHub is the whole thing.

Norvia Labs is a lab, not a SaaS catalog. Experiments start open (source, issues, and notes ship together), may graduate, pivot, or be archived in public. Each one does one thing well.

## Docs

- [About](https://norvialabs.com/about/): The lab's thesis, principles, and how experiments are built and shipped
- [Experiments](https://norvialabs.com/experiments/): Full portfolio of open-source experiments
- [Contact](https://norvialabs.com/contact/): Reach the team or propose a contribution

## Experiments

- [forge](https://forge.norvialabs.com/): Agentic harness for running tools, loops, and policies. Thin core, pluggable models, deterministic replays. Rust. Active — [source](https://github.com/norvialabs/forge)
- guard: Control-plane proxy for agent traffic — MCP governance, ephemeral agent identity (ZTNA), real-time execution safety that stops loops and bad commands. Rust. Queued
- contract: API translation that turns existing enterprise backends into clean tool schemas agents can call without hand-written wrappers. Rust. Queued
- route: Context optimizer that prunes unused tool schemas from the prompt to cut token cost and latency. Rust. Queued
- audit: Structured, cryptographic audit ledger for every action the gateway processes, built for enterprise compliance. Rust. Queued

## Optional

- [GitHub org](https://github.com/norvialabs): Source code, issues, and repositories as they come online
